note: Notes for the command list (docs/command_list.md). The list itself comes from the fighter's data: every move in Stances[0].Moves shows up by itself with its input, frame data and animation. Here, keyed by the ENGINE move name (MoveSettings.MoveName), you can give a move a display name, a description, tags, an input to show instead of the worked-out one, which states the preview plays, a group to merge it into, or hide it. extra = rows the data can't show (moves reached by holding a button or by a state change).

5A.desc: A quick jab with the hilt of the sword. Press A again for 5AA. Mainly starts stagger pressure strings.

5AA.desc: (Placeholder: 5B animation.) She thrusts the sheathed sword while moving forward. Good for stagger pressure, not safe on block. A again for 5AAA.

5AAA.desc: (Placeholder: 5C animation.) Last hit of the autocombo.

5B.desc: Long-reach mid slash. Your main button in footsies.

5C.desc: Heavy slash. Cancels into specials, EX moves and 6C.

2A.desc: Quick low. Starts most low-to-high pressure.

2B.desc: Low poke. Chains into 5B, 5C, 2C and jump.

2C.desc: Sweep (Sixth Form, Scarlet Sky). Knocks down.

4A.desc: Close slash with a tight hitbox. A fast check up close.

6C.name: Rising Slash
6C.desc: Launches. Any ground normal cancels into it on hit or block. Jump (8) on hit to chase into an air combo; no jump cancel on block.

j.5A.name: j.A
j.5A.desc: Fast air jab. Air-to-air and the start of air combos.

j.5B.name: j.B
j.5B.desc: Wide air slash. Your main jump-in.

j.5C.name: j.C
j.5C.desc: Big downward slash. Ends air combos and covers below you.

Iaido.desc: Stationary quickdraw: a long lightning slash straight ahead. Judith: on hit or block it cancels into any special. Judith (prototype): hold the button to charge it: Tap 85% damage, Bud (15F) 100%, Bloom (35F) 112%, pops them up and cancels into another special. D drops the charge.

Iaido: Rising Cut.desc: Quickdraw cut diagonally upward. Anti-air that launches. Judith: on hit or block it cancels into any special. Its hit floats them long enough to charge the next special to Bloom. Judith (prototype): hold the button to charge it: Tap 85% damage, Bud (15F) 100%, Bloom (35F) 112%, pops them up and cancels into another special. D drops the charge.

EX Iaido: Thunder Barrage.name: Thunder Barrage
EX Iaido: Thunder Barrage.desc: Stationary six-hit slash barrage. The last hit blasts them away (hard knockdown).

Low Slash.name: Low Slash
Low Slash.desc: (Placeholder: 2C animation.) A slashing low attack straight from the motion. Judith (prototype): hold the button to charge it: Tap 85% damage, Bud (15F) 100%, Bloom (35F) 112%, pops them up and cancels into another special. D drops the charge.

Lightning Slash-Through.desc: (Placeholder: the old slash-through.) She slashes them from the front and passes through to the other side. Very unsafe on block. Judith (prototype): hold the button to charge it: Tap 85% damage, Bud (15F) 100%, Bloom (35F) 112%, pops them up and cancels into another special. D drops the charge.

EX Dash Slash.desc: Invincible lightning dash. On hit she slashes through them again and again.

Teleport Slash.name: Crescent Slash
Teleport Slash.desc: Two-hit rising crescent slash. A rises about as high as Leticia's 623A and isn't invincible; a hard knockdown early in a combo. B starts invincible and goes higher. Judith (prototype): hold the button to charge it: Tap 85% damage, Bud (15F) 100%, Bloom (35F) 112%, pops them up and cancels into another special. D drops the charge. Invincible only from the release, never during the hold.

EX Teleport Slash.name: EX Crescent Slash
EX Teleport Slash.desc: Invincible two-hit rising crescent. On hit she turns into lightning at the peak, slashes straight down onto them, holds them while she sheathes, and the click unleashes a last slash (hard knockdown).

Skyfall Slash.desc: Diving slash from the air. Slams airborne opponents down. Judith (prototype): hold the button to charge it: Tap 85% damage, Bud (15F) 100%, Bloom (35F) 112%, pops them up and cancels into another special. D drops the charge.

EX Skyfall Slash.desc: Invincible dive. The lightning X on landing is a pillar that launches them (+3 on block).

Counter · Thunderclap.desc: Counter stance. When it catches a hit she crosses through them four times, then sheathes on her own side: the final cut lands the moment the blade clicks home.

Throw.desc: Close range. 4 + B+C throws behind you. Break a throw with B+C within 10 frames.

Air Throw.desc: Also grabs an opponent you're juggling (a hit-grab: air normals cancel into it on hit, and it can't be broken). Ends the combo and places your Link Break crest (it can never spend it).

Sakura Morning Moon.desc: Invincible lightning dash. On hit she cuts through them back and forth, launches them with a rising slash, then turns into lightning and strikes straight down through them. They hang in the air while she kneels and sheathes: the click sets off the last cut, a burst of cherry blossoms and a white flash. When the screen comes back she is standing and they fall into a hard knockdown under falling petals.

5D.name: 5D (Drive placeholder)
5D.desc: (Placeholder: Iaido's slash as a normal.) Her D normals will be her own Drive moves, like BlazBlue's. Chains like her other normals.

2D.name: 2D (Drive placeholder)
2D.desc: (Placeholder: 2C's sweep.) Chains like her other normals.

j.D.name: j.D (Drive placeholder)
j.D.desc: (Placeholder: j.5C's slash.) Chains like her other air normals.

Palm Strike.name: Palm Strike
Palm Strike.desc: Open-palm strike on 214D. Judith (prototype): hold the button to charge it: Tap 85% damage, Bud (15F) 100%, Bloom (35F) 112%, pops them up and cancels into another special. D drops the charge. (Charged with D, so D can't drop it.)

Link Break: Moonlit Stillness.name: Link Break: Moonlit Stillness
Link Break: Moonlit Stillness.desc: Only while LINK READY (three crests). The world goes still: one lightning draw through them leaves them Unbalanced on their feet (60-frame stagger, no Burst). She ends behind them; hold back as it ends to land in front. Cancels from normals and specials.

Link Call S1.name: Link Break: Partner 1
Link Call S1.desc: Only while LINK READY. Partner 1 comes at once and leads the Link Break (its Link version: Eren / Harie / Adin wall bounce, Mary's buff twice as long + stagger).

Link Call S2.name: Link Break: Partner 2
Link Call S2.desc: Only while LINK READY. Partner 2 leads the Link Break.
